title: Theros Beyond Death Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane of gods, mortals and the Underworld.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God of the sun who brings a dawn no night can follow.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the sea who brings a flood nothing can withstand.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead who brings a death none can escape.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the forge who brings a fire to recast the world.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of the hunt who brings a wilderness no law can tame.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: God of destiny who describes Kroxa.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God who is generous with gifts and unforgiving of debts.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God of storms whose displeasure is foretold by distant thunder.

entities.name: Kroxa
entities.description: Being of unending hunger given form.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: Planeswalker who calls on a song for death and the dead.

entities.name: Taranika
entities.description: Akroan veteran who thinks Kytheon watches over them.

entities.name: Kytheon
entities.description: Hero thought to keep watch over the Akroans.

entities.name: Renata
entities.description: Hunter who led the best hunters of Theros on a quest against the Nessian boar.

entities.name: Pantor
entities.description: Man blinded by the light of hope to the world's ills.

entities.name: Akroans
entities.description: Mountain-fortress people who have learned not to anger Thassa.

entities.name: Skophos
entities.description: Minotaur polis unknown to humans for centuries.

entities.name: Setessan wilds
entities.description: Wilds terrorized by the Nessian boar.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: Realm reached by Arasta's webs.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm of the dead that webs reach into.

entities.name: Arasta of the Endless Web
entities.description: Spider whose webs reach from Nyx to the mortal world and the Underworld.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God whose hound guards the Underworld.

entities.name: Kunoros
entities.description: Hound of Athreos who stops escapes from the Underworld.

events.summary: Renata leads the best hunters in Theros on a quest against the terror of the Setessan wilds.
events.quote: Renata led the best hunters in all of Theros on a quest to bring down the terror of the Setessan wilds.

relations.quote: Three sharp barks announce an attempt to escape the Underworld.

relations.note: Klothys describes Kroxa as unending hunger given form.
relations.quote: He is unending hunger given form.
